services.name: Couples lessons
services.desc: Operation 36 is a structured golf program where beginners learn by playing on the course from day one. Golfers start 25 yards from the green, playing nine holes with a goal of shooting 36 or better. Once achieved, they move back, progressing toward the full tee box. Participants join group coaching, skill-building activities, and track progress through the Operation 36 app. Ready to improve and have more fun? Sign up today! Discounts available for Wildhorse Resort & Casino/CTUIR Employees and CTUIR Tribal Members. All Wildhorse Resort & Casino Season Pass Memberships will have OGA Memberships/Dues attached - $55 per member application ($30 Junior) Ask staff for more details, if needed. Golf

services.name: RV Park / Tipi Village
services.desc: At Wildhorse, every camper is a happy camper being just steps away from our 24-hour casino and live entertainment. Our RV Park is all about convenience and comfort. Guests can enjoy access to resort amenities, complimentary shuttle service and more! At check-in, present your Club Wild players card, Good Sam, AARP, Tribal, AAA or Veterans card for a discount. Pull thru and back-up spaces with full hook-ups available in 30 and 50 amps. Heated outdoor pool and hot tub, laundry room, showers, restrooms and WiFi. Our guests can also enjoy free access to our Fitness Center and Business Center. Or relax in our indoor pool and hot tub near the hotel front desk - always a guest favorite to unwind.
